question: Should OpenClaw accept read-scoped runtime-config drift path names and per-cache-hit disk snapshot reads as the health diagnostic tradeoff for this PR?
rationale: The code path is additive and well-covered, but tests cannot decide the auth-adjacent visibility boundary or the operational cost of doing a disk config read on each cached health response.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
options.body: Land after exact-head CI because the diff is additive, redaction is tested, and the supplied terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health path behavior.

options.title: Request Extra Privacy Or Latency Proof
options.body: Ask for a read-vs-admin transcript or a health latency sample if maintainers are not comfortable with drift path visibility or per-request disk reads.

options.title: Pause For Companion Policy PR
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers decide diagnostics and the hot-mode restart policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89517 must land together.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head CI because the diff is additive, redaction is tested, and the supplied terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health path behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent merged the adjacent health cache/status PR and is the clearest owner signal for accepting the health payload and cache-hit behavior tradeoff.
